question: Who are our top customers by total spend?
sql:
SELECT oi.user_id, u.first_name, u.city, u.state, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS total_spend
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.users` u ON u.id = oi.user_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 20
report: Analyst conventions applied here: (1) revenue is always computed from order_items.sale_price, never from orders (orders has no monetary column); (2) exclude Cancelled and Returned items so spend reflects real, kept revenue; (3) identify customers by user_id + first name + location only — never expose email or address. The report ranked the top 20, highlighted spend concentration (what share of revenue the top 1% brings) and suggested a retention play for high-value accounts.
